description: On-demand content consumption platform. Industry brain defines what type of content is consumed. This core defines how content discovery, playback, and progression work.

three_js.description: Smooth undulating wave mesh in the background. Content-first energy. Wave responds slowly to mouse position.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Content belongs to one or more Categories
Playlist belongs to User, contains Content
Progress belongs to User and Content — tracks position and completion
Subscription belongs to User — defines access level
Download belongs to User and Content — for offline access
Review belongs to User, written about Content
Notification belongs to User, triggered by new content or creator activity

layout.notes: Autoplay and continue watching are primary engagement mechanics. Progress bar on every thumbnail is non-negotiable — it is the product's core retention signal.

avoid: Never show a content card without a thumbnail — use a branded category placeholder, never blank
Never auto-play with sound on — always muted by default in browse context
Never use a modal for content detail — navigate to dedicated content detail screen
Never show subscription prompt on first content tap — let them watch the preview first
Never use text-heavy cards — thumbnail and title only on browse grid
Never truncate content title to less than 2 lines on content detail screen
Never hide the progress bar on continue-watching cards — it is the core value signal
Never use a non-standard video player — consistent controls every time
enforce: Continue watching row always appears first when user has in-progress content
Progress bar on every in-progress content thumbnail — percentage watched
Auto-play next episode countdown — 5 seconds, cancellable
Offline download available on every content item in paid tier
Content rating and duration always shown on content detail
Playback speed control always accessible in player
Resume from exact position — never start from beginning after leaving mid-content
Category/genre always shown on content card — never content without context

empty_states.ui: Featured content hero at top. 'Trending now' row below. 'New releases' row. Never show personalised sections until 3+ items watched.
Bookmark illustration. Message: 'Your library is empty'. Sub: 'Save content to watch later'. CTA: 'Browse content'.
Message: 'No results for [query]'. Show trending searches. Show 2-3 browse categories below. Never just blank space.

loading_states.ui: Hero banner skeleton full width. Below: row label skeleton then horizontal scroll of 4-5 thumbnail skeletons 16:9 ratio. Multiple rows stacked.
Spinner centred on black background. Never show broken image. Buffer indicator on progress bar — different colour from watched portion.
Hero thumbnail skeleton top. Title 2 lines. Meta row skeleton. Description 3 lines skeleton. Episode grid skeleton.

error_flows.ui: Player shows: 'Unable to play this content'. Options: Try again, Check connection, Browse similar. Never stuck on black screen with no message.
Download item shows failed state with red icon. Retry button inline. Partial download cleaned up. Storage not consumed by failed download.
Preview plays for 30-60 seconds then pauses. Upgrade prompt overlays with: what they get, price, free trial if available. Never cut mid-sentence.
Content detail shows: 'This content is no longer available'. Suggestions for similar content below. Remove from continue watching automatically.

edge_cases.case: Content in foreign language without subtitles
edge_cases.ui: Warning shown on content detail: 'No subtitles available for [language]'. Never hide this information.
Season selector first. Episodes paginated or virtualised — never render all at once. Jump to episode input for long series.
Friendly message: 'You're already watching on [X] device(s). Please stop playback there first or upgrade your plan.' Never cryptic error code.
Auto quality reduction — show 'Switched to lower quality' toast. Manual quality selector always accessible. Buffer spinner on progress bar.
